$$\text{sum of digits} = m + a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_r, \qquad \text{product of digits} = a_1 a_2 \cdots a_r.$$

$$m = a_1 a_2 \cdots a_r - a_1 - a_2 - \cdots - a_r. \tag{$*$}$$
